_note: Repair task arising from the independent verification of ALDAZ-FT-B-001 (PMID 16941225). Verifier: mirror, under ALDAZ-VERIFY-W2-20260913; report disease-models/wwox/research/verifications/2026-09-13_aldaz_w2_verification.md, committed at 106dcd1 by the orchestrator on behalf of a rate-limited actor, content unmodified. Verdict: REFINED — 44 propositions, 36 SUPPORTED, 8 NARROWER_THAN_CLAIMED, 0 UNSUPPORTED, and all three of the reading's own declared locator corrections confirmed as repairs.
OBJECTIVE: Adjudicate each narrowing against the source, then repair the wording the source shows needs repairing in the PMID 16941225 artefacts, and file the AUTHOR_RESPONSE the review protocol owes. The verification states that none of these changes a direction of effect and none touches the two findings that make the lot valuable; the repair must preserve both while removing the overreach.
WHY_IT_IS_ON_THE_CRITICAL_PATH: The verification names these as owed BEFORE any BATCH_COMMIT that leans on this paper, and a BATCH_COMMIT for mature ORDINARY changes is one of this batch's closure items. So this is not tidying: it gates integration.
THE_RULE_THAT_GOVERNS_THIS_TASK: 🔴 A verifier finding can itself be wrong. Adjudicate each against the source before applying it, and never delete a true statement to satisfy a check. REJECTED — with the surface re-opened and what it shows — is a legitimate disposition, and so is DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED with both readings stated. A repair that over-corrects is also a defect.
WHAT_THE_VERIFICATION_CONFIRMS_AND_YOU_M: The CNS clause is SUPPORTED and is the substantive finding of the lot: every CNS cell-type statement in that paper rests on text or table only.
The limbic-cortex contradiction is CONFIRMED on both surfaces and was represented faithfully — the reading did not choose a side, and it should not start now.

All three of your declared locator corrections are repairs. The Fig. 3B pancreas correction is called the most valuable of the three; the Fig. 1 blot correction is an UNDERSHOOT repair that adds what the first version missed.

FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.entries_14_and_43_scope_the_absolutes_to: Both carry an absolute that the artefact contradicts as written. Fig. 1 lane 5 is a whole-brain lysate — a neural compartment shown in a panel — so 'the ONLY neural compartment in the paper that has a panel' is false unless scoped to immunohistochemistry. And 'NOT ONE panel shows a negative tissue' is contradicted by the paper's own panel-cited negatives: mucinous acini (Fig. 3G, which the text calls 'clearly negative'), the glomerular tuft (Fig. 2F) and Schwann cells with nerve processes (Fig. 3C) — the last two attested by your own entries 34 and 15. Scope both to IHC; the surrounding claims ('no negative-control section', 'every organ-level negative is text/table-only') stand.
FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.entry_2_absence_of_evidence: The source writes that there is 'no evidence that any other … are able to generate stable viable protein products'; the proposition renders it 'are said to lack stable protein', which converts absence of evidence into asserted absence. Also noted in the other direction: 'not a result of this paper' undersells Fig. 1, which is this paper's own single-band evidence.
FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.entry_6_scope_to_the_TMA_organs: The duplicate-core sentence is quoted exactly, but the paper also analysed WHOLE SECTIONS of breast, ovary, testis, prostate (Methods) and skin (Results). 'The paper's organ-level calls rest on a duplicate' does not hold for those five.
FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.entry_13_the_undefined_symbol: The printed facts are right — text 'negative', table '+/−'. But '+/−' is not a bin of the paper's own four-level scale, and the same text-negative/table-'+/−' pairing occurs for pituitary chromophobic cells. Reading '+/−' as 'borderline, not clean absence' is one available interpretation, not what the source defines. Re-state as the printed facts plus both readings.
FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.entry_27_drop_inverts: Text and table do disagree about the islet (intense vs ++), but the text grades acini 'strong' and islets 'intense' — both at the top, not ranked — so 'the ranking inverts between them' overstates: only the table ranks acini above islets.
FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.entry_42_the_stomach_clause_and_the_disj: The author hypothesis is quoted exactly and correctly typed IPOTESI, and the SDR assignment is indeed by motif. The counter-clause overshoots twice: stomach is graded moderate (++), not 'strongly positive'; and 'not steroid targets in any sense the paper argues' ignores the paper's own disjunction — 'either steroid targets OR related with steroids production/metabolism' — which covers liver, while the distal nephron segments it calls strongest are classical aldosterone targets. The counter rests on an untagged textbook premise; either tag it or drop it.
FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.the_resolution_anchors: Seven 'native pixels' anchors declare a resolution that was not the one used. Re-word them to the resolution actually used. 🔴 The verifier states its own WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_MY_MIND for this item: if the nine crops turn out to be sub-regions of panels rather than whole panels, 'native pixels' would be true of them. Check which is the case before conceding or rejecting.
FINDINGS_TO_ADJUDICATE.section_6_and_7_items: The verification also names a resolution-declaration defect in its §7 and two citation gaps in its §6. Read those sections and dispose of each.

AUTHOR_RESPONSE: 🔴 Owed by you, and silence is not acceptance (Annex C, peer review). File it as part of the repair record: per finding, ACCEPTED / REJECTED / DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED, with the surface and resolution you re-opened.
PROCEDURE_THAT_BINDS_THE_MANIFEST_EDITS: These entries are PERSISTED locators. Editing one is its own act: re-inspect the surface at original resolution BEFORE drafting, declare contradicts_locator as the object the validator requires with its audit object, run the blind locator audit on the contradicted triples, and run `python3 framework/scripts/locator_contradiction_audit.py --working-tree --fail-on-undeclared` before committing any manifest edit. 🔴 Never rewrite a persisted receipt — a receipt is history; if a repair changes what the reading covered or concluded, that is a NEW appended event.
ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: Each finding above has an explicit disposition with the surface re-opened named.
